summary: Iteration 139 - BidBlitz Mobility AI Route Recommendations Testing Complete. All backend APIs (17/17 tests PASS) including new AI recommendation endpoint. Frontend AI recommendation card displays correctly with headline, summary, provider badge (openai/gpt-5.2), best option, alternative, and watchouts in German. All 6 transport options remain visible and functional.

backend_api_tests.ai_recommendation_endpoint: PASS - /api/mobility-platform/ai-recommendation returns valid AI response with provider=openai, model=gpt-5.2
backend_api_tests.ai_recommendation_german_response: PASS - AI returns German language headline, summary, and watchouts
backend_api_tests.ai_recommendation_best_option: PASS - AI returns valid best_option_type and secondary_option_type
backend_api_tests.ai_recommendation_empty_options_400: PASS - Returns 400 when options array is empty
backend_api_tests.route_endpoint: PASS - /api/mobility-platform/route returns 6 transport options with prices
backend_api_tests.nearby_endpoint: PASS - /api/mobility-platform/nearby returns vehicle counts and markers
backend_api_tests.payment_options_endpoint: PASS - /api/mobility-platform/payment-options returns wallet balance and 5 payment methods

frontend_tests.login_and_navigation: PASS - Login with admin@bidblitz.com and navigation to /mobility-map works
frontend_tests.pickup_auto_fill: PASS - Pickup field auto-populated via GPS fallback (Mati 1, Matiqan, Kosovo)
frontend_tests.dropoff_autocomplete: PASS - Typing 'Berlin Hauptbahnhof' shows search results panel
frontend_tests.search_result_selection: PASS - Clicking search result sets destination
frontend_tests.price_comparison_button: PASS - 'Preise vergleichen' button triggers route calculation
frontend_tests.ai_recommendation_card: PASS - AI recommendation card visible with data-testid='mobility-ai-recommendation-card'
frontend_tests.ai_provider_badge: PASS - Provider badge shows 'openai' with data-testid='mobility-ai-provider-badge'
frontend_tests.ai_best_option: PASS - Best option shows 'Beste Wahl: Mietwagen' with data-testid='mobility-ai-best-option'
frontend_tests.ai_watchouts_list: PASS - Watchouts list visible with German tips
frontend_tests.transport_options_display: PASS - All 6 transport types displayed (Taxi, E-Scooter, Fahrrad, Mietwagen, Airport Shuttle, VIP Chauffeur)
frontend_tests.wallet_balance_display: PASS - Wallet balance shown in header

ai_recommendation_via_universal_key.details: POST /api/mobility-platform/ai-recommendation returns valid AI response using EMERGENT_LLM_KEY with provider=openai, model=gpt-5.2

fallback_chain.details: Fallback chain configured: openai/gpt-5.2 -> gemini/gemini-3-flash-preview -> anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-5. Primary provider (openai) working correctly.

existing_endpoints_after_ai_integration.details: /api/mobility-platform/search and /route endpoints continue to work correctly after AI integration

frontend_ai_card_in_bottom_sheet.details: AI recommendation card displays in bottom sheet after selecting pickup and dropoff

ai_card_content.details: AI card shows headline, summary, provider badge (openai), confidence (74%), best option (Mietwagen), alternative (VIP Chauffeur), and watchouts in German

price_comparison_6_transport_types.details: All 6 transport options visible: Taxi (€1948.34), E-Scooter (€425.84), Fahrrad (€271.93), Mietwagen (€460.48), Airport Shuttle (€682.58), VIP Chauffeur

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 139 verified the new AI Route Recommendations feature in BidBlitz Mobility Platform. The /api/mobility-platform/ai-recommendation endpoint uses EMERGENT_LLM_KEY (Universal Key) with primary provider openai/gpt-5.2. Frontend displays AI recommendation card with headline, summary, provider badge, best option, alternative, and watchouts in German. All 6 transport options remain visible and functional. Test file updated with 4 new AI recommendation tests.
